novel_features.name: Weekly library review
novel_features.description: Turn recent saves, unfiled elements, duplicate connections, AI flags, and missing attribution into a deterministic maintenance queue.
novel_features.rationale: Cosmos is used continuously but offers no reproducible terminal review across local history and multiple collections.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it before a weekly curation session to see exactly what needs attention.

novel_features.name: Collection overlap
novel_features.description: Compare two collections and report shared elements, duplicate media, and references unique to each side.
novel_features.rationale: A SQLite join across collection connections answers a question no individual Cosmos request or existing tool can answer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to keep project moodboards distinct and avoid recycling the same references.

novel_features.name: Search coverage gap
novel_features.description: Compare live Cosmos search results with live collection membership and return promising references that are not already saved.
novel_features.rationale: Combining the live discovery graph with local membership turns search into an actionable coverage check.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when a board feels repetitive and you need genuinely new references.

novel_features.name: Provenance audit
novel_features.description: Report missing source URLs or authors and show source concentration from live collection elements.
novel_features.rationale: Cosmos emphasizes attribution, but existing exporters preserve whatever metadata exists without auditing completeness.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it before publishing or handing off a moodboard so references remain attributable.

novel_features.name: Similarity trail
novel_features.description: Walk visual similarity results to a bounded depth and emit a deduplicated, source-aware graph.
novel_features.rationale: The API exposes one-hop similarity; bounded traversal makes a discovery path reproducible and agent-readable.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to explore a visual direction without losing the path back to the seed reference.

novel_features.name: Snapshot diff
novel_features.description: Compare historical collection membership and show added, removed, and moved elements.
novel_features.rationale: Existing scrapers overwrite results, while local snapshots can explain how a research library changed over time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to audit a team's curation changes or reproduce an earlier moodboard state.

narrative.headline: Search, organize, export, and audit your Cosmos inspiration library from the terminal.
narrative.value_prop: cosmos-pp-cli mirrors the replayable Cosmos GraphQL surface, then adds confirmed writes, JSON and HTML exports, local membership snapshots, cross-collection analysis, and attribution-aware workflows. Browser automation was used only during development discovery; normal commands use ordinary HTTP and remain scriptable.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public discovery commands work without a token. Personal collections and writes use a Cosmos bearer token supplied through `COSMOS_TOKEN`. Run `cosmos-pp-cli auth identify --json`, then create a tenant-gated client profile whose credential reference is `env:COSMOS_TOKEN`; credentials are never included in exported manifests or JSON output.

troubleshoots.fix: Set `COSMOS_TOKEN`, run `cosmos-pp-cli auth identify --json`, and validate the tenant-gated client profile. Replace an expired token in the environment rather than storing credentials in CLI configuration.

troubleshoots.symptom: A GraphQL command reports an unknown field
troubleshoots.fix: The Cosmos web API is undocumented and may have drifted; rerun discovery or update the stored operation document.
Run `cosmos-pp-cli sync --resources collections,elements --full` at least twice before comparing history.

narrative.when_to_use: Use cosmos-pp-cli when a task involves searching Cosmos, reading or organizing collections, exporting references, preserving attribution, or answering questions across a synced inspiration library. Prefer the compound review, coverage, overlap, provenance, trail, and diff commands when the request spans more than one API operation.
anti_triggers: Do not use it as a general web image search unrelated to Cosmos.
Do not use it to generate or semantically classify images.
Do not use it for destructive bulk writes without explicit user confirmation.
